# Neo-Human
The word Neocyte derives from the Greek word "neo" meaning "new" and the Latin word "cyte" meaning "cell".
When combined, the term "Neocyte" can be interpreted literally as "new cell", but it tends to be used in a more figurative sense to evoke transhumanist vibes, being read as "Advanced" or "Beyond" Biological.
One could argue humanity invented the Neocyte species at large by extension, but, the term was only coined after other races started undergoing the same procedure.
